description: This file defines the SupplyChainClient class which is used to interact with the AWS Supply Chain service. It includes method annotations for various operations related to supply chain management, such as creating and deleting datasets, import jobs, and instances, as well as listing and updating resources.

classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Supply Chain services, extending the base AwsClient class.
